contract: Development & License Agreement between Kestrel Robotics, Inc. and Kestrel Robotics (fictional parties).

obligations.text: pay the Phase 2 milestone fee of $48,000
obligations.sourceQuote: Customer shall pay the Phase 2 milestone fee of $48,000 within thirty (30) days of acceptance of the Phase 2 deliverables.

obligations.text: deliver the platform security audit report
obligations.sourceQuote: Supplier shall deliver to Customer a platform security audit report no later than November 12, 2026.

obligations.text: notify Customer of any security incident within 72 hours of discovery
obligations.condition: within 72 hours of discovery of a security incident
obligations.sourceQuote: Supplier shall notify Customer of any security incident within seventy-two (72) hours of discovery.

obligations.text: return all Confidential Materials within 30 days of termination
obligations.condition: within 30 days of termination of the Agreement
obligations.sourceQuote: Upon termination of this Agreement, Customer shall return all Confidential Materials within thirty (30) days.

obligations.text: maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least $1M
obligations.sourceQuote: Supplier shall maintain, at its own expense, commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence.

obligations.text: deliver the Q3 API usage statement
obligations.sourceQuote: Supplier shall deliver a quarterly API usage statement within thirty (30) days after the end of each calendar quarter.

obligations.text: exchange written renewal notices for the pilot extension
obligations.sourceQuote: The parties shall exchange written renewal notices no later than the end of the pilot period.

obligations.text: pay the quarterly platform license fee of $6,000
obligations.sourceQuote: Customer shall pay a quarterly platform license fee of $6,000, due on the last day of each calendar quarter, beginning March 31, 2026.

satisfaction.note: Q3 fee paid; Q1 and Q2 cycles unreconciled
